parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Config').first().json.ANTHROPIC_MODEL, max_tokens: 600, messages: [ { role: 'user', content: `You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule:
Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do not pass the job only because it says "remote."

Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.
Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.
Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.
Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.

Keep the job only if one of these is true:
- The job says worldwide remote.
- The job says work from anywhere.
- The job says global remote.
- The job says APAC remote.
- The job allows international contractors.
- The job accepts people based anywhere.
- The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

Return JSON only, no other text:
{"taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear", "reason": "short reason", "location_risk": "low/medium/high", "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high", "contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear", "decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"}

Job post:
${$json.description}` } ] }) }}

parameters.content:
## Sources with public API/RSS
RemoteOK, Remotive, We Work Remotely (RSS), Himalayas are wired up directly.

## Needs manual setup
Wellfound, Dynamite Jobs, Work at a Startup, and Otta have no public API. These nodes are disabled stubs — wire up a scraping service (e.g. Apify) or review these sources manually each week.

## Taiwan eligibility hard filter
Regex reject/keep phrase check runs before any AI call, to save API cost on obvious no's.

## AI eligibility + scoring
Claude checks Taiwan eligibility per job, then a Code node scores it (Taiwan fit, async fit, role fit, salary) and applies the keep/reject/manual_check/apply decision logic.

## Score >= 85
Generates a tailored cover letter draft and sends an instant Telegram alert in addition to the normal daily digest.

## Daily digest
Aggregates every job processed today (kept, manual-check, rejected) into one Telegram message sent at 8:30 AM Taipei time.
